note: With USTAAD_ENFORCE_MODEL_VERSIONS=true the service reads each m2_* model's etag (BigQuery models.get, metadata only) at startup and on this interval, and compares it with currentModelVersions in model-acceptance.json. The timeout bounds the token read and each models.get call. Cloud Run may not run the timer while an instance is idle, so a result older than maxVerifiedAgeMs counts as unverified and the next guarded request checks again first. If a model could not be read (for example, the startup check timed out while the instance was throttled), the next guarded request also checks again first, but not until recheckUnverifiedAfterMs has passed since the previous check started. Requests that arrive during a check wait for it. A mismatch is not checked again on the request path; it blocks until the interval check or a maximum-age check finds the accepted etag.
